Citizen: Watch out for terrorist camps out in the
wilderness.  Luckily, they're easy to miss and hard to find.
Unless they are coming after you for something, you probably
won't see them - They typically keep to themselves.
Citizen: There's a rugged, cold and unfriendly guy in the
pub who claims to know about the Colonel who was on the news
for dissappearing, and stuff about terrorists.
He thinks he's an expert.  He won't talk to any police or
town guard though - He's really cynical and hates
government.  I think he's full of it.  I also wouldn't sit
down next to him.  He's a bit sinister, creepy guy...
